objective: one logical full-scope run R6 of the candidate 1.10.0rc6 (every CSV row 0-27 as configured; not a pilot: --rows-first only orders the plan, reading rows 22, 27, 23 to 26 and 15 first, and --term-upc names the four product pages of the review; neither narrows the scope), two lanes, read in slices, each one ledger stage of the new credential's campaign oxylabs-marianos-20261116 whose ceiling is also set in the collector (set-ceiling). In 1.10.0rc6, as in rc5, a stop at a spending ceiling finalizes the run, so every slice is ended by the operator with SIGTERM (systemctl stop, by slice_stop.sh) once the stage has its target of reservations in the ledger: a resumable stop (exit 75); the requests then in flight are held as unknown outcomes, charged against the ceiling; the ceiling, 10 above the target, is the backstop. The estimate from F2's traces (brand readings of the 7 child listings above the window included) puts a full run at 3,190 to 3,796 submissions (USD 4.79 to 5.69 at the reservation rate) against the USD 4.90 envelope (3,266 submissions): at the low end the run completes; at the high end the envelope ends first, the run is then left resumable after its last slice and the shortfall is reported with the measured rates. This slice starts the run. Its first requests verify the corrections: the Coupons page's list read as loaded or not and asked again while not loaded (OR-04), the store check of re-asks as they occur (OR-19), then rows 22, 27 and 15 (Cat Food 27021, the PPM traces, the four product pages, the named offers). Operator check during it: a second start for the store is refused (exit 9) before any request (a gate refusing every submission, no lease).

config.environment: the owner's own Azure VM (Ubuntu 24.04), PostgreSQL 16, release installed from the wheel

retry_policy: as shipped: up to 3 attempts on 408, 429 and 5xx with backoff for a first ask; a re-ask is sent once; a request set aside is asked again at most 2 more times, each at least 300 s after its previous answer or attempt; the Coupons page asked again while its list has not loaded, at most 4 answers for the run, 60 s apart (1.10.0rc6, OR-04); each submission reserved at its worst case
stop_conditions: the operator's slice target (SIGTERM: a resumable stop) before the stage's submission ceiling; the stage's submission ceiling (the collector's own ceiling and the account-wide gate); store or fulfillment not verified on a page (STORE_NOT_VERIFIED); ABNORMAL_RESULT, SITE_REFUSAL or three pages in a row not read (PROVIDER_ERROR); a ledger refusal, or more than 2 outcomes left unknown; the stage deadline; by the operator: once 10 re-asks have been answered and none recovered its request, the stage is stopped and reported as it stands
passes_when: the slice ends with the operator's SIGTERM at 150 reservations (exit 75, the run interrupted and resumable); every page verified for 53100502 PICKUP; at most 2 unknown outcomes; the second start exits 9 with no ledger row
